items.title: Amazon Aurora DSQL now supports foreign key constraints
items.blurb: Amazon Aurora DSQL now lets you add foreign key constraints to new and existing tables. Aurora DSQL is a serverless, distributed SQL database with PostgreSQL compatibility and active-active multi-Region availability.

items.title: AWS Backup adds cross-Region and cross-account backup support for Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP
items.blurb: AWS Backup now supports copying Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP backups across AWS Regions and accounts.

items.title: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 adds memory usage controls
items.blurb: Mountpoint for Amazon S3 can now limit memory usage, either automatically based on the environment it runs in or with a limit that you define.

items.title: AWS Open Sources Kiro Crew for Asynchronous Coding Agents
items.blurb: Amazon recently announced Kiro Crew, an open-source system for running multiple Kiro coding agents across sessions, tools, and tasks.

items.title: Amazon EVS now supports i7i.metal-48xl Amazon EC2 instance type
items.blurb: Today, we're announcing that Amazon Elastic VMware Service (Amazon EVS) now supports the i7i.metal-48xl Amazon Elastic Cloud Compute (Amazon EC2) bare-metal instance type, offering a higher core-count option with a newer generation…

items.title: Amazon Cognito adds admin API operation to reset user TOTP configurations
items.blurb: Amazon Cognito now provides a new admin API operation to reset a user's time-based one-time Password (TOTP) multi-factor authentication (MFA) configuration.

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer now supports unplanned shrinkage in agent schedules
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer now enables managers to input unplanned shrinkage in agent schedules, providing a more accurate picture of staffing due to unscheduled agent absences such as late logins or unplanned sick leave.
